answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The walnut lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the comet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
